summary: Assess borrower, country and trade-finance exposures with practical credit review exercises. Explore the five-day course and enrol.
lede: Cross-border credit risk training helps credit and trade-finance professionals assess repayment capacity and the risk of payment transfer across jurisdictions. It develops practical skills in borrower and counterparty assessment, country exposure monitoring, documentary-credit review under UCP 600 when expressly incorporated, and exposure aggregation. Participants practise setting limits, identifying early warnings, and preparing credit recommendations and escalation actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who review international borrowers, counterparties, country exposures or trade-finance transactions and contribute to credit decisions or portfolio monitoring.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of borrower credit analysis, financial statements or trade-finance transactions is expected. Programming is not required.
